scope: Synthetic raw-token qualification only. No manuscript files or H/F readings loaded.
candidate: Choose lexicographically first nonoverlapping eligible same-body pair per line without looking at prefix variant or follower outcome. Retain discordant sh/ch pairs. Group by page, exact body, ordered relative-position thirds floor(3*i/(L-1)) capped2, and ordered structural follower availability. Conditional exact subset test preserves one sh per retained line and stratum left-sh totals. Exact length and exact absolute positions no longer held fixed; this is the hypothesis being challenged.
support: W=sum k(n-k)/n times available followers. Retain W>=160, >=8positive pages, maxshare<=.25 as candidate gate, NOT inherited proof of power. Bonferroni8; alpha.05.
design: 100fresh trials per volume1 and4, each12pages4bodies; perpage/body volume*(7twoavailable or14oneavailable) plus20blocked lines. Randomfront0..3, back6..12;20%origin replacement,5%unknown tokens. Extra volume explicitly adds data, not a rescue of original sample. Seeds2410000+volume*10000+trial*10+scenarioindex. Five scenarios: null_low .2, null_high .6, null_layout, null_nonlinear, positive .20ch/.35sh amongavailablefollowers. Every scenario has fresh token layouts.
layout_null: Shared placement only, no prefix term in follower probabilities. Left-sh probability sigmoid(5*(zleft-zright)); outcomes sigmoid(pageeffect+lineeffect+zposition). Smooth z=6*(relativeposition-.4). Nonlinear z=2.5 if absoluteindex even else -2.5, plus 2*sin(4*pi*relativeposition). This challenges residual within-bin trends and shifted parity. Null_low/high/positive use random.5 orientation. Availability blocked by literal chx independently of orientation.
gates: Each cell100 attempted; supportadmitted>=80. Conditional power Wilson95lower>=.80 and practical power overall100 lower>=.80. Each null admitted Wilson95upper<=.10. Unsupported below80 admission; failed rates retained even if unsupported. Allcells mustpass. Report diagnostics for all attempted, no thresholdchanges or new seeds after outcomes.
verification: Reuse parser/events as function-only AST loads. All generated raw lines roundtrip preserving unknown slots. Pair grouping and support invariant under outcomes. Exact subset smallcase exhaustive oracle. Frozen source/protocol/import hashes checked. Synthetic availability definition does not qualify real-world availability inference.
limits: First-pair selection and coarse thirds are frozen choices, not optimized. Additional sample volume is separate. Failure of this candidate does not rule out all shift-tolerant methods. No semantic or grammar claims.
